_note: r.164(3)(f) and (6)(f): "is a director in any company". The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2025-26 and TY 2026-27 (W-090d, D-652 G1a): for TY 2025-26 it is Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (IE) (Income-tax Rules, 1962, kept live by r.164(14)); the question names no section, so one wording serves both years.
question: Were you a director in any company at any time during the tax year?

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-20032026-271092, Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.164(3)(f), p.1662; r.164(6)(f), p.1663; egazette 2019/201697, Income-tax (Second Amendment) Rules, 2019, G.S.R. 279(E), Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (IE), p.250
